reliability_note: Unverifiable. The hosting doc carries no date beyond 'Page updated' and the file-type doc says 'Updated: 7 years ago'. I could not retrieve a Castbox-hosted feed to probe enclosures: castbox.fm/rss/<id> 302s to a 404 page, and every Castbox channel I opened turned out to be a client for someone else's feed (e.g. a Megaphone feed). So 'unlimited total storage' is a claim with no working retrieval path I could confirm.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
